resources.string: "A saved operation needs reconciliation. Your original selections and operation key are retained."
"A verified subscription is required to save or forward originals. Previewing your approved photos remains available."
"By continuing, you consent to use your registered face to authenticate this account."
"Choose photos, review matched people, and approve exactly what to share."
"Choose photos when you want to upload. Register your face with three fresh camera photos to authenticate your account."
"Each person receives only the photos shown in their subset, after they accept."
"Enter your saved private recovery backup. Then take one fresh selfie to restore its registered account."
"Excluded people receive none of your photos."
"Face sign-in, photo matching and upload processing have separate consent choices."
"Keep this backup somewhere you can access on another device. It works together with your registered face."
"Lovelies uses the system photo picker. Your library is not scanned automatically."
"Make sure your face is well lit,\nin focus, and centered."
"Matched people are allowed by default unless blocked. Photos still need approval before access."
"Newest first. Search and photo source apply across your authorized library."
"Open a photo review from your gallery."
"Open a photo review to see its matched people here."
"Open a photo to review its matches."
"Protected previews are held in memory while you view them. Sign-out clears private photo references and local capture files."

"Register your face using the camera to sign in. Choose photos to upload, then review each matched person’s exact photo subset. Sharing sends a request; accepted requests create access. You can exclude a person globally or uncheck an individual photo for them."
"Request a copy of your data. The status below is reported by the server."
"Review matched people before sharing any photo."
"Save a private backup key to recover this account with a fresh selfie on another device."
"These choices are separate from face authentication. Turning matching off revokes matching access; turning it back on does not restore old access."
"These preferences are saved to your account."
"This photo is unavailable. Return to your gallery and refresh current access."
"This review is limited to the photos and matched people shown. Additional photos require a separate review."
"Uncheck a person to exclude this photo from their subset."
"Choose which photos Lovelies can access.\nYou review what to share."
"We've matched your photos\nto the people in them."
"Your face is registered and you’re signed in."
"Your outgoing photo requests will appear here."
"Sign-in, face capture, matching, upload and sharing are simulated. No photos or account data leave this app."
"Get the best matches\nacross your entire library"
"Start with a few photos\n(you can change this anytime)"
"Cloud sources appear when available in your Android photo or file picker."
"Photo access requires your approval for each matched recipient. Blocked people are excluded."
"Great matches!\nYour photos found people\nin your memories."
"Help us improve by letting us know\nthis isn't the right match."
"“%1$s” has been noted in this local preview. No report has been sent."
"Help Lovelies find you in photos\nacross your matches."
"Face the camera in even light. Keep your eyes visible, hold the phone steady, and capture three different angles. Face capture is simulated in this preview."
"Matched people are allowed by default unless blocked. You still review and approve photos before sharing."
"Allow future matching and sharing with this person? Previous access and excluded photos are not restored."
"Block sharing with this matched person? They will also be removed from the current sample share."
"Choose who can find you through matching. Photos still need sharing approval."
"You choose each photo and recipient\nbefore sharing."
"Lovelies needs access to your\nphotos to find people in them."
"Photo access preference saved in the preview"
"Clear %1$s MB of sample cache? Your photos and matches will stay in this preview."
"Download a copy of your\nphotos, matches and profile data."

"Profile: %1$s
Sample library: 18 photos
Matches: 12
Sharing preferences: included

This is a local front-end preview. No download or external request was made."
"Add photos, capture three preview selfies, explore your matches, and choose exactly which photos and people to share with. These actions use local sample data."
"For this front-end preview, feedback stays on this device. No message has been sent. You can review every screen from the All 48 screens menu."
"Authentication is simulated in this front-end preview. No real password is stored or changed."
"Return to the local preview welcome screen?"
"This resets only sample profile preferences stored in this preview app. No real account exists or will be deleted."
"Your people are out there.\nKeep sharing your photos\nand we'll find them!"
"Choose From Files to select photos on this device."
"Choose From This Device to select photos."
"Review this selfie. Face quality will be checked after you use it."
"Your previous request will stay saved on this device. This does not cancel it on the server."
"Android may defer work. Each accepted chunk remains saved."
"Photos you can access as a recipient."
"Your favorite photos will appear here. Load more to find favorites outside this page."
"Open Android Settings and allow storage access to save originals on this Android version."
"No installed app can share this photo."
"In the Android file picker, open Browse and choose %1$s. Its app must be installed, signed in, and available as a file provider. Only the photos you choose are added to Lovelies."
"This person is excluded from all sharing."
"Only checked photos will be included for %1$s."
"Your requests are saved. Access starts after each person accepts."
"All approved photos are available to the accepted recipients."
"Some approved photos are available. Check each person’s status."
"No photos are currently available from this operation."
"Explicit screenshot review with local sample data"
"Find matches in the photos I choose to upload"
"Allow my registered face to appear as a possible match"
"Android grants access only to the photos you select"
"You can allow notifications later in Android Settings."
"Private previews will be loaded again only after a current authorization check."
"This sends your account deletion request for review."
"This replaces any previous recovery key. Save the new backup before changing devices."
"This clears the revoked device’s authentication reference."
"The server verified that the removed face reference is gone."
"Reference removal failed. Check the status before setting up another profile."
"Reference removal is blocked by unresolved work. Check the status again."
"Sign-in and matching have stopped. Reference removal is still pending."
"Previous reference cleanup: %1$s. Your current profile remains separate."
"This change was cancelled by the server. No saved capture can be reused."
"The profile update is complete. Verify your face once to sign in."
"The server response is saved. Current sign-in still needs confirmation."
"Fresh captures are required. Your original account and device key remain saved."
"Reference cleanup must finish before a new profile can be enrolled."
"Your original account and key are saved. A fresh face sign-in must be confirmed by the server before private access returns."
"Your change is saved on this device. Check its server status before continuing."
"Future matching and receiving stop. Previous candidate access is retired; face sign-in and upload processing stay separate."
"Allow your face profile to produce future matches. Previously revoked access stays retired."
"Take three fresh selfies to update this registered reference. Face sign-in uses the new reference; previous matching access is retired."
"Face sign-in will stop. If photo matching is off, the unused face reference will also be removed. Upload processing stays separate."
"Consent to use your retained registered reference for authentication, then take one fresh selfie. Photo matching and processing are separate choices."
"Face sign-in and matching stop. Your account and uploads remain. Removal status stays visible until the server verifies cleanup."
"Consent to face sign-in using a new profile and take three selfies. Photo matching stays off until you choose it."
"The server has confirmed that this guest account was deleted. You can start again when you’re ready."
"We can’t retrieve this request’s status. This does not confirm deletion. Your saved receipt remains on this device."
"The approval window has ended. This does not confirm deletion. Resume setup only after the same guest account is verified again."
"The deletion request was rejected. You can resume setup after the same guest account is verified again."
"The deletion request was cancelled. You can resume setup after the same guest account is verified again."
"Deletion could not finish. Check the status again for an update. Your account is not confirmed deleted."
"Deletion is in progress. Completion will appear here after the server confirms cleanup."
"Your deletion request is saved for review. Face setup is paused while this request is unresolved."
"We couldn’t confirm whether the request reached the server. Check status to reconcile your saved request."
"Request deletion of this guest account before registering your face. The request requires review; submitting it does not mean deletion is complete."
"We couldn’t save this change on your device. Your previous account state has been kept. Try again when device storage is available."
"We couldn’t verify this account or its deletion status. Check status again; no new guest account has been created."
"This allows future matching and sharing. Previous access and excluded photos are not restored."
"Add photos to find the people in your memories."
"Only currently eligible matches appear in a review."
"Your previous sign-in photo may still be processing. Wait for its saved challenge to expire before taking a fresh selfie."
"The saved sign-in must be recovered on this original account and device. No new account was created."
"A capture or verification is still in progress. Check its status before retaking."
"Check the saved profile change before continuing. Your original account and device key are retained."
"Verify your registered face to finish establishing private profile management."
"Profile management is unavailable. If face sign-in is still authorized, verify your face on this original device and explicitly renew an expired control."
"This private control is still current. It does not need renewal."
"Continue the saved fresh face sign-in. Status alone cannot authenticate your account."
"Reference removal has not been verified. Check its status before enrolling another profile."
"There is no retained active reference for this action. Check the removal status."
"The saved profile authority changed. No new access was granted. Check the current status."
"The saved profile change could not be written safely. Keep this installation and retry its status."
"Configure the API endpoint for this build before continuing."
"The service could not be reached. Check your connection and try again."
"This device holds setup or identity for another account. It has been preserved; use the backup for that same account."
"Sign out of the current account before recovering an account with a backup key."
"Saved recovery history is full. No previous request or device key was removed."
"Your recovery photo is still being checked. Check status before taking another photo."
"Enter the full saved recovery backup, beginning with LVR1."
"This device does not have that private backup. Create a new recovery key while signed in and save it."
"That recovery key is unavailable. Your saved request has been kept; no replacement account was created."
"We couldn’t save recovery on this device. Your previous account and keys have been kept. Free device storage, then try again."
"Check the saved account recovery request before continuing."
"The recovery response did not match your saved account and device. Your original request has been kept."
"Your previous photo is still being checked. Check again before taking another photo."
"We couldn’t save your setup on this device. Your original account and device key have been kept. Free device storage, then try again."
"The original device key is unavailable. Setup cannot continue on a replacement key."
"We couldn’t recover this account’s setup. No new account has been created. Check your connection and try again."
"Your saved setup no longer matches the server. Check your original account before continuing."
"Recover your existing face setup before continuing."
"Face verification is unavailable. Try again when the service is ready."
"Enable photo processing in Photo Preferences before uploading."
"Your session changed. Verify your face again to continue."
"The face could not be verified. Retake a clear camera photo and try again."
"Matches or permissions changed. Open a fresh review before sharing."
"Your upload is saved. Free device storage, then resume."
"The saved photo is unavailable or changed. Cancel unfinished uploads and select it again."
"This upload does not match your current account or saved photo. Its original details have been kept."
"This unfinished upload expired. Cancel it before choosing the photo again."
"Your photo bytes are saved. Resume to check finalization."
"Upload paused. Resume when you are ready."
"Processing is still pending. Check your photos again shortly."
"The server confirmed account cleanup. You can start again with a new guest account."
"Your original deletion request is saved privately on this device. Keep this installation to check its status. Completion is shown only after the server confirms cleanup."
"Sample devices: %1$s, %2$s and %3$s. Remove one sample device from this preview?"
